raw_results.original: In developing countries including Turkey, tuberculosis is still a major problem. In pulmonary tuberculosis BCG test was positive in 100% of cases and the PPD test in 44.5%. Similarly, BCG test was positive in 100% of military tuberculosis and tuberculous meningitis cases but PPD test was negative in all of them.
